sloka: पुलस्त्येनापि सन्त्यक्तो राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान् ।परिष्वक्तः कृतातिथ्यो लज्जमानो विनिर्जितः ।। ७.३३.१९ ॥
transliteration: pulastyenāpi santyakto rākṣasendraḥ pratāpavān ।pariṣvaktaḥ kṛtātithyo lajjamāno vinirjitaḥ ।। 7.33.19 ॥

translations.english: The mighty lord of Rakshasas, Ravana, though released by Pulastya, embraced, and offered hospitality, felt ashamed, having been defeated.
